mapper.select: SELECT user_idx FROM user_mst WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_page_filter (user_idx, page_code, filter_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{pageCode}, CAST(#{filterJson} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (user_idx, page_code) DO UPDATE SET filter_json = EXCLUDED.filter_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
